name: الفاتحة
description: The opening chapter of the Quran, recited in every prayer; encapsulates worship, divine mercy, and the prayer for guidance upon the straight path.

name: البقرة
description: The longest Surah, addressing community guidance, legislative principles, faith, stories of Adam, Abraham, and Moses, and Ayat al-Kursi.

name: آل عمران
description: Emphasizes the unity of God, discusses Maryam and Prophet Jesus (Isa), and reflects on steadfastness in testing times.

name: النساء
description: Focuses on social justice, family laws, protection of orphans, women's rights, and inheritance equity.

name: المائدة
description: Details dietary laws, fulfillment of covenants, social ethics, and accounts of Jesus and his disciples.

name: الأنعام
description: Profound theological discourse establishing Tawhid (monotheism), divine dominion over the cosmos, and natural signs.

name: الأعراف
description: Narrates the moral struggles of humanity, prophetic histories, and the covenant of humankind with their Creator.

name: الأنفال
description: Revealed post-Badr, addressing moral conduct during conflict, reliance on God, and ethical distribution of resources.

name: التوبة
description: Addresses treaties, sincerity in faith, charity, repentance, and standing firm in moral conviction.

name: يونس
description: Contemplates divine wisdom in the creation of heavens and earth, sun, moon, and stories of Prophet Jonah and Moses.

name: هود
description: Chronicles stories of past civilizations and prophets (Nuh, Hud, Salih, Lut) illustrating justice and perseverance.

name: يوسف
description: Referred to as the 'Best of Stories', recounting Yusuf's patience through betrayal, imprisonment, and ultimate forgiveness.

name: الرعد
description: Focuses on cosmic signs, thunder praising God, water flowing in valleys, and tranquility of the heart through remembrance.

name: إبراهيم
description: The mission of Prophet Ibrahim, gratitude for divine blessings, and the parable of a good word as a firm tree.

name: الحجر
description: Guarantees divine preservation of the Quran and highlights cosmic harmony, winds fertilizing clouds, and humility.

name: النحل
description: Celebrates natural bounties, animal biology, rain, botanical variety, and the architectural and medicinal wonder of the honeybee.

name: الإسراء
description: Begins with the miraculous Night Journey; outlines foundational moral commandments: honoring parents, humility, and justice.

name: الكهف
description: Contains the Companions of the Cave, the Man of Two Gardens, Musa and Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn, teaching humility and faith.

name: مريم
description: Tenderly recounts the miraculous birth of Prophet Yahya to Zakariya and Prophet Isa (Jesus) to Maryam.

name: طه
description: Relates the spiritual calling of Prophet Musa at the burning bush, facing Pharaoh, and the prayer for expanding knowledge.

name: الأنبياء
description: Highlights cosmic origins (heavens and earth stitched together, living things made from water) and unity of prophetic messages.

name: الحج
description: Examines the spiritual pilgrimage, stages of human biological development from dust to embryo, and standing against oppression.

name: المؤمنون
description: Delineates qualities of triumphant believers and famously details sequential embryonic stages of human conception and gestation.

name: النور
description: Features the majestic Verse of Light (Ayat an-Nur), societal modesty, deep-sea oceanic waves and layers of darkness.

name: الفرقان
description: Distinguishes truth from falsehood, references shadows, solar movement, barriers between bodies of water, and traits of the righteous.

name: الشعراء
description: Reiterates prophetic dedication across generations and stresses sincerity in speech and purpose.

name: النمل
description: Prophet Sulaiman and the ant colony, Bilqis of Sheba, and observations of geological mountain movements.

name: القصص
description: Traces the childhood and growth of Musa, the downfall of arrogant tyrant Pharaoh, and the danger of Qarun's greed.

name: العنكبوت
description: Addresses testing in life and provides the famous structural metaphor of the fragile home of the spider.

name: الروم
description: Historical foresight regarding Byzantine victory, diversity of languages and skin colors, atmospheric winds, and natural regeneration.

name: لقمان
description: The timeless wise counsel of Luqman to his son: humility, prayer, gratitude, and respectful speech.

name: السجدة
description: Reflects on cosmic creation, human faculties of hearing, sight, and feeling, and sincere prostration before God.

name: الأحزاب
description: Historical events of the Battle of the Trench, exemplary character of the Prophet, and societal bonds.

name: سبأ
description: Account of the Kingdom of Saba and its fertile gardens lost to dam failure due to ingratitude; iron softened for Dawud.

name: فاطر
description: Celebrates the Originator of the heavens and earth; examines multicolored mountains, layers of stone, and scholarly awe.

name: يس
description: Revered as the heart of the Quran; details dead earth revitalized by rain, solar and lunar celestial orbits, and resurrection.

name: الصافات
description: Celestial order, planetary adorning of the night sky, and moral steadfastness of Ibrahim and Ismail.

name: ص
description: Patience under hardship, the governance of Prophet Dawud and Sulaiman, and genuine repentance.

name: الزمر
description: Emphasizes pure monotheism, overlapping of night and day in spherical rotation, water springs in earth, and divine mercy.

name: غافر
description: Divine forgiveness and justice, the believer from the household of Pharaoh, and cosmic order.

name: فصلت
description: Primeval primordial smoke/gas state of the cosmos, cosmic expansion, and signs shown in distant horizons and within human beings.

name: الشورى
description: The principle of mutual consultation (shura) in communal affairs, universal revelation, and divine benevolence.

name: الزخرف
description: Distinguishes fleeting worldly ornamentation from everlasting spiritual depth and virtue.

name: الدخان
description: The Night of Decree, cosmic balance, and consequences of defying moral conscience.

name: الجاثية
description: Signs in the heavens, creation of living organisms, marine navigation, and the judgment of human actions.

name: الأحقاف
description: Cosmic balance with truth, honoring parents, maternal gestation and weaning periods, and warning to 'Ad.

name: محمد
description: Moral rectitude, standing against tyranny, humanitarian treatment of captives, and sincere charity.

name: الفتح
description: Revealed after the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, heralding peace, tranquility in believers' hearts, and ultimate triumph of truth.

name: الحجرات
description: Universal charter of human brotherhood, prohibiting backbiting, racism, and mocking, establishing piety as true measure of nobility.

name: ق
description: Cosmic skies without rifts, regenerative rain awakening dormant vegetation, and God being closer to humanity than their jugular vein.

name: الذاريات
description: Winds dispersing clouds, pairs in all creation, and the famous verse reflecting on the continuous expansion of the universe.

name: الطور
description: Mount Sinai, the swelling sea (hydrothermal vents / oceanic swelling), and intellectual challenges against disbelief.

name: النجم
description: The descending star, the celestial ascension (Mi'raj), human accountability, and God as the Lord of Sirius.

name: القمر
description: The parting of the moon, historical reminders, and the repeated refrain: 'And We have indeed made the Quran easy to understand.'

name: الرحمن
description: The Masterwork of Divine Mercy; balance in the cosmos, two bodies of water meeting without exceeding their barrier, and pearls.

name: الواقعة
description: The ultimate reality, three categories of humanity, positions of the stars, rain, seed germination, and fire production.

name: الحديد
description: Discusses sending down iron with its formidable strength and utility, social spending, and light on the Day of Judgment.

name: المجادلة
description: Defends rights of vulnerable women, condemns covert conspiracies, and elevates those endowed with knowledge.

name: الحشر
description: Circulation of wealth among the needy, community unity, and the exalted Most Beautiful Names of God (Asma al-Husna).

name: الممتحنة
englishNameTranslation: She that is to be examined
description: Ethical relations with people of different beliefs: dealing kindly and justly with those who do not wage war.

name: الصف
description: Consistency between word and action, dedication to righteousness, and the message of Isa (Jesus).

name: الجمعة
description: Purification through knowledge, the importance of Friday congregational prayer, and leaving worldly trade for worship.

name: المنافقون
description: Exposes psychological deceit, encouraging charity before mortality overtakes human life.

name: التغابن
description: All creation glorifies God; emphasizes conscious living, family harmony, generosity, and trusting divine decree.

name: الطلاق
description: Fair and compassionate legal ethics during divorce, provision for women, and trusting God to make a way out.

name: التحريم
description: Domestic tranquility, sincere repentance, and exemplary faithful women (Asiya, Maryam) standing independent in virtue.

name: الملك
description: Life and death as tests; flawless cosmic heavens without flaw or fissure, bird flight mechanics, and water subterranean reservoirs.

name: القلم
description: The sacred role of the pen and literacy, moral dignity of the Prophet, and the cautionary parable of the greedy garden owners.

name: الحاقة
description: The undeniable reality of reckoning, honesty in receipt of one's book of deeds, and the sublime integrity of revelation.

name: المعارج
description: Relativistic dimensions of time ('a day whose measure is fifty thousand years'), human impatience, and charitable steadfastness.

name: نوح
description: Prophet Nuh's patient preaching, seeking forgiveness for rain abundance, and contemplation of lunar reflected light and solar lamp.

name: الجن
description: The unseen dimension listening to the Quran, affirming Tawhid, and rejecting superstitious attributions.

name: المزمل
description: Night vigil prayer (Tahajjud), rhythmic measured recitation of the Quran (Tartil), and spiritual fortitude.

name: المدثر
description: Call to rise and warn, personal purification, abandoning malice, and patience in divine service.

name: القيامة
description: The self-reproaching soul, reconstruction of individual human fingertips/fingerprints, and embryonic stages of conception.

name: الإنسان
description: Origins of man from drop of mingled fluid, providing food to the needy out of pure love, and celestial reward.

name: المرسلات
description: Winds bringing rain, mountain anchors balancing earth, and pure fresh water supply for humanity.

name: النبأ
description: Mountains as stabilizing stakes (Awtad), sleep for rest, solar blazing lamp, pouring cloudbursts, and lush vegetation.

name: النازعات
description: Celestial motion of stars and angels, vast canopy of heaven raised without pillars, and spreading of the earth's crust.

name: عبس
description: Compassion over worldly status prompted by the blind seeker Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum; seed germination through rainfall.

name: التكوير
description: Solar collapse, dispersal of stars, condemnation of female infanticide, and morning respiration (photosynthetic dawn).

name: الانفطار
description: Cosmic cleaving, symmetrical balanced design of the human anatomy, and recording guardians of deeds.

name: المطففين
description: Condemnation of economic cheating in weights and measures; integrity in trade and the registry of human actions.

name: الانشقاق
description: Cosmic obedience to divine command, gradual human progression through stages (Tabaqan 'an Tabaq).

name: البروج
description: Constellations of stars, perseverance of the martyrs of faith, and the Preserved Tablet (Lawh Mahfuz).

name: الطارق
description: Pulsating nocturnal star, human biological creation from ejaculated fluid, the returning sky (water cycle), and cracking earth.

name: الأعلى
description: Glorification of the Creator who proportions all things, brings forth green pastures, and turns them into dark stubble.

name: الغاشية
description: Invites human observation: how camels are anatomically crafted, sky elevated, mountains set firm, and earth spread.

name: الفجر
description: The ten sacred nights, lessons from ancient civilizations (Iram), caring for orphans and poor, and the tranquil soul.

name: البلد
description: Mankind created into struggle; conquering the steep uphill road through freeing captives, feeding the hungry, and kindness.

name: الشمس
description: The sun and its radiance, moon reflecting light, day and night alternation, and purification of the human soul.

name: الليل
description: Diverse efforts of people: the generous and mindful given ease, while the stingy self-satisfied meet difficulty.

name: الضحى
description: Comfort and reassurance to the Prophet: God has neither forsaken you nor is displeased; caring for orphans and petitioners.

name: الشرح
description: Expansion of the chest/heart with clarity and peace; famous assurance: 'Indeed with hardship comes ease.'

name: التين
description: The fig, olive, Mount Sinai; affirming humanity is created in the finest stature and mold (Ahsan Taqwim).

name: العلق
description: The very first revelation: 'Read in the name of your Lord who created', creation of man from a clinging clot, and the pen.

name: القدر
description: The Night of Power and Destiny (Laylatul Qadr), more beneficial than a thousand months, marked by peace until dawn.

name: البينة
description: Clear evidence of truth, worshiping God with sincere undivided faith, establishing regular prayer and charity.

name: الزلزلة
description: Geological convulsion of the earth yielding its burdens; accountability down to the weight of an atom of good or evil.

name: العاديات
description: Swift war horses striking sparks with hooves; human ingratitude and passionate love for wealth.

name: القارعة
description: The shattering calamity, people like scattered moths, and mountains like fluffed-up carded wool.

name: التكاثر
description: Cautionary critique of materialistic competition and obsession with accumulation until visiting the graves.

name: العصر
description: Oath by Time; humanity is in loss except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and counsel one another to truth and patience.

name: الهمزة
description: Condemnation of slander, backbiting, and hoarding wealth under the illusion of immortality.

name: الفيل
description: Historical defeat of Abraha's invading army of elephants marching against the Kaaba, routed by flocks of birds.

name: قريش
description: Reminds Quraysh of divine security in seasonal trade caravans and calls for worshiping the Lord of the House.

name: الماعون
description: Defines true religion through social compassion: reproaching those who turn away orphans and withhold simple neighborly assistance.

name: الكوثر
description: The shortest Surah, promising the Prophet boundless abundance (Al-Kawthar) and assuring enemies will be cut off.

name: الكافرون
description: Uncompromising principle of freedom of worship: 'To you be your religion, and to me mine.'

name: النصر
description: Final complete Surah revealed, signaling victory and peaceful conquest of Mecca, calling for praise and seeking forgiveness.

name: المسد
description: Addresses the relentless opposition of Abu Lahab and his wife against truth and human dignity.

name: الإخلاص
description: The definitive statement of pure monotheism: God is One, Eternal, Unbegotten, and None is comparable to Him.

name: الفلق
description: Seeking divine sanctuary from darkness, negative jealousy, and unseen malice.

name: الناس
description: Final chapter seeking refuge in the Lord, King, and God of mankind from insidious whisperers in human hearts.
